name: Grenoble-Alpes-Isère

runway.v: Paved runway 09/27, 3,050 m × 45 m (plus grass 09R/27L 900 m × 50 m)

hours.v: Aerodrome open Mon–Sat 07:00–21:00 local, Sun and holidays 08:00–21:00 local (Mon–Sat 0600-2000 UTC winter, 0500-1900 UTC summer); hours can be extended on request for private, official and commercial flights
hours.quote: LUN-SAM 0600-2000 ; DIM et JF 0700-2000 MON-SAT 0600-2000 ; SUN and HOL 0700-2000

customs.v: Customs on prior notice: 24 hours Mon–Fri, 48 hours at weekends and public holidays

ppr.v: Prior permission for code C aircraft or larger, via business aviation (businessaviation@grenoble-airport.com); handling PPR 48 h for commercial flights
ppr.quote: PPR PN 48 HR for commercial flights.

deicing.v: De-icing provided 15 Nov to 15 Apr (Type 1 and Type 2)

notes: Read the SIA eAIP AD 2 LFLS PDF in the 29 Oct 2026 set (most pages AIRAC AMDT 08/26, 06 Aug 2026). French AIP times are UTC in winter and one hour earlier in summer. No night ban is stated; the aerodrome is closed outside its hours unless extended on request. Customs works on notice only. Between 1 Dec and 30 Apr the aerodrome administrator runs the published schedule; from 1 May to 30 Nov there is a note on flights outside Schengen (check AD 2.3 before a non-Schengen trip). Emergency flights: OPS Business Aviation +33 (0)4 76 93 49 43.
